name: compare_regions
description: Read two regions from the selected data source and compare them byte-by-byte. Returns similarity percentage, matching/differing byte counts, SHA256 of each region, and the first N differing offsets. Useful for finding embedded duplicates (version strings, repeated configs), detecting code reuse, or checking if a region was patched. For diffing two separate files, use diff_data_sources instead.

address_a.description: Start address of the first region

size_a.description: Size of the first region in bytes (clamped to data source size)

address_b.description: Start address of the second region

size_b.description: Size of the second region in bytes (clamped to data source size)

max_diff_regions.description: Maximum number of differing offsets to return (1-10000)
